title: Creating Your First Content Entry
excerpt: Learn how to create and manage content in HaruCMS with our step-by-step guide. We'll walk you through creating your first entry and understanding the editor.
content:
Creating content in HaruCMS is simple and intuitive. Let's walk through the process of creating your first entry.

Getting Started

To create a new entry, navigate to the Collections section and select your collection. Click the "New Entry" button to open the editor.

The Editor

The editor provides a clean interface for managing your content fields. Each field type has its own controls and validation.

Fill in your content, set the status to "published" when ready, and click save. That's it!
